BiblicalUsage: Seventh marks the day, the year, and the son. In the seventh year the Hebrew servant goes out free, on the seventh day the priest looks again at the plague, and the fast of the seventh month shall be joy and gladness to the house of Judah. In the genealogy, David is the seventh son of Jesse.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the seventh keeps pointing to rest and completion. The servant goes free, the fast turns to feasting, and the youngest son becomes king, and I hold that God's sevens always end in freedom.
